name: Relevance
description: The extent to which the response is relevant to the provided context and interesting fact.

name: Engagement
description: The degree to which the response is engaging and interesting to the reader or listener.

name: Clarity
description: The clarity and coherence of the response, including the use of clear and concise language.

name: Creativity
description: The level of creativity and originality in the response.

name: Insightfulness
description: The depth of insight and thoughtfulness in the response.
